makeup_failure_scope: unit_isolated: one unit's makeup line failure does not interrupt the other units' water intake; multi-unit scenarios are concurrent independent unit-level failures, NOT a common-cause source outage
energy_gap_definition: positive integral of terminal-Pg minus actual total Pg; not EENS
shed_semantics: shed_action_total_mw = sum of per-stage shed actions (legacy accounting, may exceed system load and is NOT an unserved-energy figure); shed_peak_mw = largest per-stage cumulative shed; neither is EENS/MWh; static_grid_shed_mw = deenergized_shed_mw + collapse_shed_mw + vcls_shed_mw + uvls_shed_mw + grid_ufls_shed_mw, i.e. it is a MIXTURE of causes and must not be read as 'VCLS shed'; the additive decomposition is exact and is checked by metric_audit; grid_ufls_shed_mw is UFLS applied inside the cascade and is zero in coupled runs, where the frequency-layer UFLS amount is imposed as a uniform load scaling before the cascade stage and reported separately as ufls_shed_mw
hard_failure_definition: modelled_hard_service_loss: H = 1[F3_deenergized]; F3 = island without an in-service source, or island whose AC power flow has no solution at any load level; NOT physical equipment damage
h_load_definition: load-weighted hard-service-loss ratio = sum(PD_MW over H buses) / sum(PD_MW); reported alongside H_count because buses carry unequal load
impact_class_definition: N3 = H > 0 (aligned 1:1 with F3); N2 = emergency control/shedding without hard service loss; N0 = none. Class is an operational label, not a severity rank, and is not interchangeable with H
time_definition: t_first_H_s = elapsed seconds from t=0 makeup interruption to the first cascade stage that produced any F3 bus; blank if H=0
solver_warning_note: solver health of the AC power-flow path; False means internal convergence is NOT proven and reported H values are conditional on this limitation
